title: Stable typed slots, dense iteration and finite identity

environment.language: ISO C17; edition comparisons bounded by actually inspected sources
environment.target: Hosted Linux x86-64; exact-width integer types required
environment.dependencies: Original mechanisms from typed objects, loops and supplied allocation callbacks; host verification tools are separate. No mechanism-providing collection library.

passages: llvm/ADT/SmallVector.h: inline capacity, object size, storage and API guidance

limitations: No exact published C17 text inspected.
Public executable anchors do not execute every written extension, independent measurement or delayed transfer.

rubric.criterion: Prove both directions of the dense/rank bijection and distinguish stable address, stable logical identity, stable iteration order and owner lifetime.

levels.0: Absent or contradicts the stated representation/contract.

levels.2: Provides the complete stated result, a justified invariant and independently checked falsification evidence.
levels.3: Transfers the argument to the changed assumptions without a worked solution, identifying the revised costs and limits.
